verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Dunning Agent that reviews payment history and chases overdue invoices, plus filters for spotting unpaid invoices. Neither documents automatic payment retries on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence, or any measured recovery of involuntary churn. The 3-attempt retry in the docs applies to webhook delivery, not failed payments, so it is unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn
